title: Nobody Gets Lost In Our CORN Maze 🌽
description:
At our corn maze, if the lanterns go out while you're still inside, you stay the night. In twenty years nobody has, because a voice in the corn tells you where to turn.

Tonight is the farm's last night. At two minutes to ten, the farmer walked in alone.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment LEFT if you'd have turned left too.
